# Requirements Extraction Prompt

## Model
**Use Claude Opus 4** for deep requirements extraction.

## LLM Attribution
All output documents MUST include:
- Excel: Add "Metadata" sheet with `LLM_Model: Claude Opus 4`, `Generated_Date: {timestamp}`
- Markdown: Header with `Generated by: Claude Opus 4 | Date: {timestamp}`

## Context
You are extracting requirements from project documentation for **${project_name}** in the **${domain}** domain.

## Input
- **Extracted Documents:** Read from `output/extracted/${project_name}/` folder (markdown files)
- **Domain:** Core Banking/Payments (SEPA, SEPA INST, ISO 20022)

## Requirements Structure

Extract each requirement with the following fields:

### Required Fields
| Field | Description | Format |
|-------|-------------|--------|
| REQ_ID | Unique identifier | `${project_name}-{TYPE_PREFIX}-{NNN}` |
| Title | Short descriptive name | Max 100 characters |
| Description | Detailed requirement | Full description |
| Type | Classification | FUNCTIONAL, NON_FUNCTIONAL, INTEGRATION, COMPLIANCE, DATA |
| Priority | Business priority | CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW |

### Type Prefixes
- FUNCTIONAL → FUNC
- NON_FUNCTIONAL → NFR
- INTEGRATION → INT
- COMPLIANCE → COMP
- DATA → DATA

### Traceability Fields
| Field | Description | Example |
|-------|-------------|---------|
| Source | Document and location | `Incoming_v20240612.vsdx - Page 3` |
| Components | System components involved | `RTG, Cassandra, Kafka` |
| Traceability | Standards/regulations | `ISO 20022 pacs.008, SEPA SCT Inst` |

### Testability Fields
| Field | Description | Format |
|-------|-------------|--------|
| Acceptance_Criteria | Testable criteria | Given/When/Then or measurable |
| Status | Extraction status | Always `DRAFT` for new |

## Extraction Rules

### 1. Identify Requirements From:
- Process flows and sequence diagrams
- Validation rules and business logic
- Error handling descriptions
- Timeout and SLA specifications
- Data transformations and mappings
- Integration points and API contracts
- Compliance statements

### 2. Requirement Quality:
- Each requirement should be **atomic** (single capability)
- Use **SHALL** for mandatory, **SHOULD** for recommended
- Avoid ambiguous terms: "fast", "user-friendly", "efficient"
- Include measurable criteria where possible

### 3. Type Classification Guide:

**FUNCTIONAL:**
- User actions and system responses
- Business rules and validation logic
- Processing workflows

**NON_FUNCTIONAL:**
- Performance (latency, throughput)
- Security (authentication, encryption)
- Availability (uptime, failover)
- Scalability requirements

**INTEGRATION:**
- API contracts and interfaces
- Message formats (pacs.008, pacs.002)
- System interconnections (RTG, TIPS, Kafka)

**COMPLIANCE:**
- Regulatory (PSD2, SEPA rulebook)
- Standards (ISO 20022)
- Audit and logging requirements

**DATA:**
- Data models and schemas
- Field mappings and transformations
- Persistence requirements

### 4. Acceptance Criteria Format:
```
Given [precondition]
When [action/event]
Then [expected outcome]
```

Or measurable format:
```
The system shall [action] within [time] with [accuracy/reliability]
```

## Output Format

Generate requirements in the following structure (for Excel export):

```
REQ_ID | Title | Description | Type | Priority | Source | Components | Acceptance_Criteria | Traceability | Status
```

## Example Requirements

### FUNCTIONAL Example:
```
REQ_ID: JOVI-FUNC-001
Title: Validate IBAN Format
Description: The system shall validate that the beneficiary IBAN follows the ISO 13616 format before processing the payment request.
Type: FUNCTIONAL
Priority: CRITICAL
Source: Incoming_v20240612.vsdx - Validation Flow
Components: Validation Service, RTG Gateway
Acceptance_Criteria: Given a payment request with IBAN field, When the IBAN is submitted, Then the system validates format per ISO 13616 and rejects invalid IBANs with error code AC01.
Traceability: ISO 13616, SEPA Credit Transfer Rulebook v2024
Status: DRAFT
```

### NON_FUNCTIONAL Example:
```
REQ_ID: JOVI-NFR-001
Title: Payment Processing Latency
Description: The system shall process instant payment requests end-to-end within 10 seconds under normal load conditions.
Type: NON_FUNCTIONAL
Priority: CRITICAL
Source: Incoming_v20240612.vsdx - SLA Requirements
Components: RTG, TIPS, Cassandra
Acceptance_Criteria: 99.9% of payment requests shall complete within 10 seconds measured from receipt to confirmation.
Traceability: SEPA Instant Credit Transfer Scheme Rulebook
Status: DRAFT
```

### INTEGRATION Example:
```
REQ_ID: JOVI-INT-001
Title: RTG to TIPS Failover
Description: The system shall automatically failover from RTG to TIPS when RTG becomes unavailable, ensuring continuous payment processing.
Type: INTEGRATION
Priority: HIGH
Source: Outcoming_v20260129.vsdx - Failover Diagram
Components: RTG, TIPS, Circuit Breaker
Acceptance_Criteria: Given RTG is unavailable for >30 seconds, When a new payment request arrives, Then the system routes to TIPS and logs failover event.
Traceability: High Availability Architecture Spec
Status: DRAFT
```

## Instructions
1. Read through all document chunks carefully
2. Identify statements that describe system behavior, rules, or constraints
3. Transform each into a structured requirement
4. Assign appropriate type and priority
5. Create testable acceptance criteria
6. Link to source document location
7. Output as structured data for Excel export

## Output Path
Save to: `${output_path}` (default: `output/generated_docs/extracted_requirements.xlsx`)
